items.label: Context
items.text: A rewards capability is being pulled out of a wallet system into its own service. Data sits across several relational tables and document collections, in separate databases per region.

items.label: Decision
items.text: Dual-write to old and new systems, backfill during that window, then cut over. Kafka-backed asynchronous migration with a tracking table recording which records migrated and which failed.

items.label: Trade-off
items.text: Harder to deploy than a one-shot script, but it scales, can be re-run safely, and gives a reconciliation report per setup.
